description: Weekly, minor and patch grouped, each release at least 7 days old (security fixes excepted). Majors and 0.x minors are held back. Cargo.lock only (devlog/v1.2.x-ci-cd.md D5); the Rust toolchain gets its own MR (D4).

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: it runs a plain `cargo update`, which bypasses the 7-day age check for every transitive crate.

customManagers.description: The channel pinned in rust-toolchain.toml, and the Rust version cargo runs at inside Renovate (constraints.rust above): one MR bumps both.

packageRules.description: Consumers pin this crate by tag and resolve their own lockfiles: update Cargo.lock only, never raise a floor in Cargo.toml (D5).
Pin CI and Dockerfile images by digest; digest updates then come in the grouped MR.
Semver-major updates are done by hand.
A 0.x minor is a breaking change (sysinfo, rand, async-compression, ...): treat it as a major.
One MR for all minor, patch and digest updates.
The toolchain is always its own MR (D4). It stays red on the .toolchain check until ci/build-image.sh is run and image: in .gitlab-ci.yml is pushed onto the branch.
